items.computation: Appointment day is Monday, 14 Dec 2026. 'Werktage' here run Monday to Saturday (Sunday excluded). Counting back from the appointment day: 1 Werktag before Monday 14 Dec is Saturday 12 Dec (Sunday 13 Dec is skipped as it is not a Werktag); 2 Werktage before is Friday 11 Dec 2026. So a cancellation must reach the practice by Friday, 11 December 2026 at the latest to satisfy the 'at least two working days before' requirement. This is a private contractual request, not a statutory deadline, so the exact cut-off depends on the practice's own counting convention; treated with medium confidence.

warnings: The '2 Werktage vorher' cancellation deadline is only approximate: the letter does not specify whether the appointment day itself counts, so the exact last day to cancel (around 11-12 Dec 2026) should be confirmed with the practice if cancellation is needed.
